title: 2016 PIT DART fact backfill 및 KRX-DART 식별자 연결

evidence.silver_join_audit: security_master company_id 3,220 values; financial_facts company_id 845 values; intersection 0
evidence.root_cause: security_master uses KRX ticker as company_id while DART facts use corp_code, and the earliest 2016 decision lacks a complete 2014Q4--2015Q3 fact chain

objective: 2016 검증 시작일에 필요한 2014Q4~2015Q3 분기 fact를 PIT-safe하게 보강하고, 검증된 ticker↔corp_code bridge를 통해 Silver/Gold 조인이 실제로 성립하게 한다.
assumptions: corpCode.xml은 식별자 증거일 뿐 미래 재무정보가 아니다. exact six-digit ticker 일치만 허용하고 회사명 유추는 금지한다.
corpCode.xml raw receipt와 backfill plan은 immutable Bronze/artifact로 저장하며 재시도는 같은 plan_id와 검증된 receipt만 재사용한다.

requirements: list_disclosures retrieves all pages in ascending page_no order, deduplicates by rcept_no, rejects invalid/contradictory pagination metadata and never equates page 1 with complete coverage.

The corpCode.xml raw payload is persisted before use. Reject unsafe XML, blank or non-six-digit tickers, blank corp codes, and one ticker mapped to multiple corp codes. load_corp_codes remains a backward-compatible projection.

The plan includes only common-share instruments available at validation_start, exact ticker mappings, and four fiscal periods ending with the latest quarter that can legally be available before validation_start. For 2016-01-04 the result is exactly 2014Q4..2015Q3.

The runner supplies only the sorted mapped corp_codes for its batch to collect_dart_disclosures; the collector requests each corp code through paginated list_disclosures and never falls back to an all-corporation range query. A filing is selected only if periodic, in required_periods, mapped by the frozen bridge, and published no later than its decision cutoff. Corrections remain distinct identities and existing available_at selection decides their PIT use.

Fact identities and canonical records preserve ticker plus corp_code. Silver normalizes company_id to verified ticker, preserves dart_corp_code and ticker provenance (including empty schema), and drops unmapped/mismatched records fail-closed. next_krx_session_open behavior is unchanged.

The runner writes artifact_root/dart_backfill/<plan_id>.json before fact requests. It contains canonical-input SHA-256 plan_id, required periods, mapping receipt hash, sorted mappings/unresolved tickers, selected identities, offset/limit, Bronze receipt hashes, source counts, and ticker-period coverage.
The runner fails before collection if master/map is absent, bridge has zero mappings, or batch is empty. Incomplete coverage is reported per ticker and never promoted to Gold eligibility.
No network tests. Complexity is O(DART pages + disclosures + fact rows), with no KRX×disclosure cartesian product.

scenarios.expected_behavior: All paginated receipts are returned once in deterministic order.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_list_disclosures_collects_all_pages_deduplicates_and_orders() -> None:
    from datetime import date
    from src.integrations.dart.client import DartApiClient

    pages = {"1": {"status": "000", "total_page": "2", "list": [{"rcept_no": "20150515000002", "rcept_dt": "20150515", "corp_code": "001", "corp_name": "A", "report_nm": "분기보고서 (2015.03)", "rm": ""}]}, "2": {"status": "000", "total_page": "2", "list": [{"rcept_no": "20150515000001", "rcept_dt": "20150515", "corp_code": "001", "corp_name": "A", "report_nm": "분기보고서 (2015.03)", "rm": ""}]}}
    client = DartApiClient(api_key="key", request_json=lambda _endpoint, p: pages[p["page_no"]])

    rows = client.list_disclosures(date(2015, 1, 1), date(2015, 12, 31))

    assert [row["rcept_no"] for row in rows] == ["20150515000001", "20150515000002"]

def test_backfill_plan_requires_exact_ticker_to_corp_code_bridge() -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
    import polars as pl
    from src.data.dart_backfill import build_dart_historical_backfill_plan
    from src.integrations.dart.client import DartCorpCodeRecord

    master = pl.DataFrame({"instrument_id": ["KRX:005930", "KRX:000001"], "ticker": ["005930", "000001"], "share_class": ["common", "common"], "valid_from": [datetime(2010, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)] * 2, "valid_to": [None, None], "available_at": [datetime(2010, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)] * 2})
    records = (DartCorpCodeRecord(ticker="005930", corp_code="00126380", corp_name="A"),)

    plan = build_dart_historical_backfill_plan(security_master=master, corp_code_records=records, validation_start=date(2016, 1, 4), validation_end=date(2016, 12, 29), corp_code_receipt_hash="a" * 64)

    assert plan.required_periods == ("2014Q4", "2015Q1", "2015Q2", "2015Q3")
    assert dict(plan.ticker_by_corp_code) == {"00126380": "005930"}
    assert plan.unresolved_tickers == ("000001",)

def test_filing_identities_attach_frozen_ticker_and_required_period_only(tmp_path) -> None:
    import json
    from datetime import date
    from src.integrations.dart.xbrl import DartXbrlCollector

    path.mkdir(parents=True)
    path.joinpath("payload.json").write_text(json.dumps({"records": [{"rcept_no": "20150515000001", "corp_code": "00126380", "report_nm": "분기보고서 (2015.03)", "rcept_dt": "20150515"}, {"rcept_no": "20151115000002", "corp_code": "00126380", "report_nm": "분기보고서 (2015.09)", "rcept_dt": "20151115"}]}), encoding="utf-8")

    rows = DartXbrlCollector.filing_identities_from_bronze(tmp_path / "bronze", start=date(2015, 1, 1), end=date(2015, 12, 31), ticker_by_corp_code={"00126380": "005930"}, required_periods=frozenset({"2015Q1"}))

scenarios.expected_behavior: A plan artifact exists before collection and freezes mapping plus required periods.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_backfill_batch_writes_deterministic_plan_artifact_before_fact_collection(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
    import json
    import polars as pl
    from src.data.dart_backfill import DartHistoricalBackfillRequest, run_dart_historical_backfill_batch
    from src.integrations.dart.client import DartCorpCodeRecord

    class Collector:
        def fetch_corp_code_records(self):
            return (DartCorpCodeRecord(ticker="005930", corp_code="00126380", corp_name="A"),)
    master = pl.DataFrame({"instrument_id": ["KRX:005930"], "ticker": ["005930"], "share_class": ["common"], "valid_from": [datetime(2010, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)], "valid_to": [None], "available_at": [datetime(2010, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)]})
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.data.dart_backfill._load_security_master", lambda _root: master)
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.data.dart_backfill._persist_corp_code_receipt", lambda **_kwargs: "c" * 64)
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.data.dart_backfill.collect_dart_disclosures", lambda **_kwargs: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr("src.data.dart_backfill.DartXbrlCollector.filing_identities_from_bronze", lambda *_args, **_kwargs: ())

    request = DartHistoricalBackfillRequest(bronze_root=tmp_path / "bronze", artifact_root=tmp_path / "artifacts", silver_root=tmp_path / "silver", validation_start=date(2016, 1, 4), validation_end=date(2016, 12, 29), retrieved_at=datetime(2016, 1, 4, tzinfo=UTC), offset=0, limit=1)
    plan = run_dart_historical_backfill_batch(request=request, dart=Collector())

    payload = json.loads((tmp_path / "artifacts" / "dart_backfill" / f"{plan.plan_id}.json").read_text())
    assert payload["ticker_by_corp_code"] == {"00126380": "005930"}
    assert payload["required_periods"] == ["2014Q4", "2015Q1", "2015Q2", "2015Q3"]
